legalActionStrings.description: List of OpenSpiel legal action strings. Only included if includeLegalActions is true.

legalActions.description: List of OpenSpiel legal action integers. Only included if includeLegalActions is true.

playerId.description: ID of the agent receiving this observation.

Player 'x' has placed their piece in the center column (Column 3), which is statistically and strategically the strongest opening move in the game. In a 7-column board, the center column is involved in the highest number of potential winning combinations (vertical, horizontal, and diagonal).

As player 'o', it is crucial to contest the center to prevent player 'x' from gaining control and to build your own potential connections. The standard and most effective response to a center opening is to also play in the center column (Column 3) or in an adjacent column (Column 2 or 4). Playing in Column 3 directly blocks player 'x' from building a vertical line in the most important column and secures your own presence there. This move is mathematically one of the few responses that minimize the first-player advantage in a perfect-play scenario.
